# xmatters_service (Resource)

Create or update a service in your xMatters instance.

Services are the business, technical, and external services performed by, within, or available to your enterprise – and the teams supporting them. Each service has a group assigned as its owner — a group can own multiple services, but each service can only have one owner.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Basic:
resource "xmatters_service" "basic_service" {
  name = "Shopping Cart"
  type = "APPLICATION"
}

// Advanced:
resource "xmatters_service" "create_modify_service" {
  name        = "Shopping Cart"
  description = "Service to monitor shopping cart abandonment rates"
  type        = "APPLICATION"
  tier        = "GOLD"
  owner       = "a9e17d0e-6082-47af-b656-ff34a12736b3"
  links = [
    {
      link_text = "Shopping Cart Service"
      url       = "https://github.com/my_account/Shopping_Cart_service"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the service.
- `type` (String) xMatters service type. Available options are: TECHNICAL, APPLICATION.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the service.
- `links` (Attributes Set) List of user-specified links for the service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--links))
- `owner` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the group that owns the xMatters service. A service can only have one owner, but a group can own multiple services.
- `tier` (String) xMatters service tier. Available options are: PLATINUM, GOLD, SILVER, BRONZE.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the xMatters service.
- `last_updated` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `links`

Required:

- `link_text` (String) Link text displayed to the user.
- `url` (String) Direct URL for the link.
